title: 2025 年陕西中考英语
source: 2025年陕西中考英语试题及参考答案
note: A卷；听力1—20题和选家庭照片的50题未收；按扫描原卷补齐缺句，32题选项B更正为ear；阅读C图文已转写。

sections.title: 第一场雪
sections.passage: Nana looked out of the window. It was starting (21) . Soon, the ground turned white. She stood at the window and watched until it was getting dark outside. The trees and ground (22) by white snow. Nana felt happy and was thinking about snowmen. She loved making snowmen, and tomorrow she could wear her new (23) to make the first snowman of this winter with her dad. When Nana woke up the next morning, the sunshine (24) in through her bedroom window. Her dad was already up and dressed. He knocked (25) the door and came into her room with the smell of cold and fresh air clinging to (附着于) his coat. He had (26) milk in his hand. “Get up, sleepyhead,” he said with a smile. “Can you guess (27) ?” He winked (眨眼). Before Nana could give the answer, her father went on: “It (28) almost up to your knees!” Nana jumped out of her bed, dressed (29) , and rushed to the window for a look. Then she ran to the kitchen and sat down at the table. While eating, she talked with her father (30) about the snowman they would build. This year, they decided they would make the biggest snowman ever!

items.exp: 地面变白说明下雪，start to snow。
过去树和地面被雪覆盖，用 were covered。
手套通常成双，填复数 gloves。
when 引导的过去时间背景中，阳光当时正照进来，用 was shining。
knock at the door 为固定搭配。
milk 不可数，表示一杯用 a glass of。

options: how long will the snow last
how long the snow will last
items.exp: 猜雪多深用 how deep，宾语从句用陈述语序。
It 后用单数 is。
Nana 自己穿衣，用反身代词 herself。
修饰 talked 用副词 excitedly。

sections.title: 和爸爸堆雪人
sections.passage: Right after breakfast, Nana and her father put on their warm clothes and went into the yard. There were few cars on the road because of the snow. Many people chose to work at home but Nana’s mother (31) , — she had to work the night before at the local hospital. Nana made a small snow ball and rolled it on the ground happily. The ball soon turned into the size of a big snowman’s (32) . Now Father joined in and together they began rolling another much bigger one for the snowman’s body. When the (33) became almost half as tall as Nana’s dad, they rolled it to the middle of the yard. Father helped Nana to (34) the snowman’s head on its body and made the snowman’s eyes and nose. Finally, they went to get two branches (35) the snowman still needed two arms. They also made sure the branches were (36) enough so that birds could stand on them to sing their cheerful songs. Suddenly, Nana seemed that she had forgotten (37) ! She rushed into the house and then out she came with a hat and a scarf in her hand. Father knew what Nana (38) and he held her up to let her dress the snowman up. (39) of them went inside after everything was done. Then Nana sat by the window and looked out at the snowman and the gate of the yard. She was waiting for the return of her (40) from work to see the great piece of artwork that she and her father had created!

items.exp: 妈妈在医院上班，不能在家工作，用 couldn’t。
先滚成雪人的头 head。
第二个大雪球 ball 用来做身体。
把头放到身体上，用 put。
因为还需要手臂，所以去拿树枝，用 because。
树枝需要足够结实 strong，才能让鸟站上去。
感觉忘记某件事，用 something。
爸爸明白她想做什么，meant 表示意思或意图。
Nana 和爸爸两个人回屋，用 Both。
联系开头，在等待妈妈 mother 下班。

sections.title: 有爱好的生活（五选五）
sections.passage: Do you think you are a happy child? What makes a boy or girl happy? (41) We know sayings are wise and true. Do you have a hobby? Many, many people have hobbies. Albert Einstein had a hobby. He played the violin very well. This hobby made the great scientist happy and helped him work better. Quan Hongchan, a famous sports star, has a hobby too. She has a lot of little dolls and they make her very happy. As for me, collecting stamps is my hobby. (42) Hobbies bring people together and help them become friends. I have a friend Jenny and she’s from the UK. She likes collecting stamps too. (43) We like to talk about stamps. Jenny says she is interested in the stories behind each stamp. She often asks me about Chinese stamps and shows some of them to me. Now we are very good friends. Today, people send emails to each other. They don’t use stamps often. (44) We both find we can learn many things from the small, colorful pieces of paper, Jenny emails and tells me she even uses the stamps to share things about China with the people around her. (45) As many people say: A life without a hobby is like food without salt.
choices: Truly, a hobby is fun and useful.
But Jenny and I still like stamps.
As the saying goes, a happy child always has a hobby.
Because of stamps, we got to know each other on the Internet.

items.exp: 下句提到谚语，本句引用快乐孩子总有爱好的说法。
It 指集邮，呼应爱好使人快乐。
前文提到共同的集邮爱好，本句说明因此在网上认识。
与很少使用邮票转折，仍然喜欢邮票。
结尾总结爱好有趣又有用。

groups.label: A
groups.title: 树木如何省钱
groups.passage: Most people agree that trees look nice. But not too many people know trees can also help us save money. Environmental scientists did some research and they learned that just one tree can save a city about 2,800 yuan over the tree’s lifetime. One way trees save money is by helping us save energy. Big trees stop the summer sun from shining directly to the buildings. Big trees block (遮挡) the winter wind. In this way, they help people to save the energy to make their homes and offices cool or warm. Saving energy means saving money! There are other ways for trees to help a city save money. For example, when it rains, a city’s sewers (下水道) fill up with water. Cities have to spend lots of money cleaning that water. But trees’ leaves and roots take in rainwater before it gets to the dirty sewers. With the help of trees, there is less water to clean and money is saved.

items.stem: What does the passage mainly talk about?
options: How trees help cities save money.
How trees make cities look nice.
items.exp: 文章集中说明树木如何帮助城市省钱。

items.stem: The underlined word “they” refers to “__________”.
items.exp: they 承接前文 Big trees。

items.stem: To better support the topic sentence of Paragraph 3, the writer __________.
items.exp: 第三段用雨水处理的例子支持主题句。

groups.label: B
groups.title: 给笔友的信
groups.passage: Dear Xiaoyun, I was so happy to read your letter. I like having a pen pal in China because I can learn so many new things. Thank you for sending me your family photo of five. Can you tell me more about your life? What things do you like to do together? I like to cook with my family. We often cook many foods and I’m getting more and more interested in basic cooking. One time we cooked Chinese food. It tasted delicious. I’m adding something special to my letter. On the back of it, I wrote the instructions for cooking my favourite meal, pasta with a meat sauce (肉酱). I hope you’ll be interested and won’t find it too difficult to learn to cook it. ▲ Sincerely, Annie PS (附言): Together with this letter, you can see a recent photo of my parents and my baby brother.

items.stem: How do Annie and Xiaoyun communicate with each other?
items.exp: 两人通过写信交流。

items.stem: What does Annie wish Xiaoyun to do according to the text?
options: To make more pen pals in foreign countries.
To come to visit her family next.
To teach her how to cook Chinese food.
To learn to cook pasta with a meat sauce.
items.exp: 第二段附上食谱，希望晓云学做肉酱意面。

items.stem: Which of the following can be put in “ ▲ ”?
options: I can’t wait to hear from you
items.exp: 书信结尾期待回信，C 最自然。

groups.label: C
groups.title: 中马合作
groups.passage: ECONOMIC TRADE AND PRAGMATIC COOPERATION BETWEEN CHINA AND MALAYSIA Trade: In 2024, the trade between China and Malaysia hit a record high of $212.04 billion, an 11.4% increase compared to the year before. China has remained Malaysia’s largest trading partner for 16 years. Malaysia is China’s second-largest trading partner and largest source of imports in ASEAN. Cooperation: The East Coast Rail Link is an important project of China-Malaysia high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. It connects the east and west coasts of Malaysia and it will continuously encourage coordinated economic development in Malaysia. The “Two Countries, Twin Parks” project continues to improve in quality. In recent years, the two countries have worked more closely in modern technology and innovation, such as digital economy, green development, AI and new energy vehicles. Culture and Tourism: In 2024, over 33,000 new Chinese students studied in Malaysia. Chinese cartoon movie Ne Zha 2 has been a great success in Malaysia since it was shown at the cinema. In 2024, Chinese tourists made 3.8 million trips to Malaysia. Now China has become a popular country that Malaysians choose to visit.

items.stem: How many parts are there in the text?
items.exp: 正文分 Trade、Cooperation、Culture and Tourism 三部分。

items.stem: The underlined word “hit” in the text probably means “_________”.
items.exp: hit a record high 表示达到新高，hit 意为 reached。

items.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the text?
options: China is Malaysia’s second-largest trading partner and largest source of imports.
China and Malaysia have worked better in new energy vehicles since 16 years ago.
Fewer than 33,000 Chinese students studied in Malaysia before 2024.
Visitors from China took 3.8 million trips to Malaysia in the year 2024.
items.exp: 正文明确说2024年中国游客到马来西亚旅行380万人次。

items.stem: 陕西有许多宁静而美丽的地方。There are many ____ and beautiful places in Shaanxi Province.
items.exp: 宁静可用 quiet 或 peaceful，形容词修饰 places。

items.stem: 在五月份，我去了陕南某地游玩。I went somewhere in the south of Shaanxi Province ____ for a visit.
items.exp: 月份前用 in；this May 也可表示今年五月。

items.stem: 它拥有“民歌之乡”的美誉。It has the name of the “____ of Folk Songs”.
items.exp: 民歌之乡用 Town、Home 或 Hometown。

items.stem: 我采摘了茶叶，也品尝了当地很多美食。I ____ there and enjoyed lots of local food.
items.exp: 过去经历用 picked，tea leaves 表示茶叶。

items.stem: 在那儿的各种经历使我增长见识，开阔眼界。____ experiences there have opened my eyes and improved my knowledge.
items.answer: Different / All kinds of / Many kinds of / Different sorts of
items.exp: “各种”可用 Different 或 kinds of 等搭配。

sections.title: 西湖断桥
sections.passage:
词库：name (v.) / good / it / have / culture / visit / hundred / most / usual / connect
The West Lake in Hangzhou attracts people all over the world. It is famous for (61) natural beauty and bridges. Of all the bridges over the West Lake, the Broken Bridge is said to be the (62) famous. Every year, quite a lot of tourists come here to (63) it. However, the name “Broken Bridge” does not mean the bridge is broken. People (64) it because it marks the end of the way that leads to Solitary Hill, a small hill close to the West Lake. And people (65) used this name since the Tang dynasty (618—907) In the Song dynasty (960-1279), the Broken Bridge became a popular sight for visitors. They would (66) come to the West Lake in winter to enjoy the beauty of the bridge, For (67) of years, the beautiful picture of Lingering Snow of the Broken Bridge has been a well-talked-about scene. And even today it is still considered as a (68) example of harmonious (和谐的) beauty between architecture (建筑设计) and nature. Poems and stories of old days helped to make a (69) between the bridge and love. For example, the story of the White Snake and Xu Xian meeting on the Broken Bridge has made it an important symbol of love in Chinese (70) .

items.exp: 修饰 natural beauty 用物主代词 its。
the most famous 构成最高级。
come here to visit，表示参观目的。
回溯命名的缘由，用一般过去时 named。
since the Tang dynasty 提示现在完成时 have used。
修饰 come 用频度副词 usually。
hundreds of 表示数百年。
修饰 example 用形容词 good。
make a connection between 表示建立联系。
Chinese culture 表示中国文化。

sections.title: 合唱需要团队合作
sections.passage: Zhao Xiang is a seventh grader who loves music. He has a good voice and is in a singing club. Recently, he had a problem. His school would hold a singing competition. His class teacher, Mr. Yao, talked to the class and they decided to sing a chorus masterpiece* at the competition. For the performance, Mr. Yao even invited his wife, a local musician, to guide the practice. Zhao Xiang thought it was a good chance for him to show his talent. At the first practice, things did not go as what Zhao Xiang had expected — he was too good to join the others. The musician was not satisfied and Zhao Xiang felt bad. Mr. Yao saw everything and he came up to Zhao Xiang and comforted him, “Please remember, Zhao Xiang, singing a chorus is NOT one person’s job. Everyone has to work together to achieve a good result.” Zhao Xiang realized that his voice would not help if he failed to work well with others. Zhao Xiang changed his way of singing — he did not sing so loud as he used to, and his voice became more mixed with the others’. He even helped the musician to train those who had trouble in singing by showing them how to breathe (换气), how to control voice and sing gracefully. The practice was hard, but everyone was happy with him — the class teacher, the musician, his classmates, and even his parents — about his development! At last, the Big Day came. The whole class was on the stage. They tried their best and they made it! When the headmaster read out first prize, everyone jumped up and shouted with joy. They threw Zhao Xiang up into the air. Zhao Xiang felt great because he knew he was not just singing for himself but for the class as a team. He learned that teamwork is needed everywhere and that teamwork is about trust and helping one another. He was so proud because he had done something important for his class! * A chorus masterpiece is a song that is well-known and is sung together by a group of people.

items.stem: What did the class decide to do at the competition? They decided to ____ at the competition.
items.answer: sing a chorus masterpiece / perform a chorus masterpiece
items.exp: 第一段说明决定合唱一首名作。

items.stem: How did Zhao Xiang feel at the first practice? He felt ____.
items.exp: 首次排练后不被认可，感到难过。

items.stem: What does the writer mainly talk about in Paragraph 4? About Zhao Xiang’s ____ and the people’s attitude to him.
items.exp: 第四段围绕改变唱法、帮助他人以及周围人认可展开。

items.stem: Who is “everyone” in Paragraph 5?
items.answer: the whole class and the class teacher, Mr. Yao
items.exp: 现场庆祝的是全班同学和班主任。

items.stem: What can we learn from Zhao Xiang’s experience?（不超过8词）We can learn that ____.
items.exp: 核心启示是团队合作的重要性。

items.stem:
[Andy is an exchange student from the UK. He and Binbin are in the Nature Club.] A: Hi, Binbin. I’m going to do a project about the Qinling Mountains.(76)_____________ ? B: Sure. What do you want to know? A: Let me see, (77)_______________________? B: They’re in Shaanxi, the center of China. The mountains are more than 2,000 kilometers long, running from east to west and dividing northern and southern China. They have a height of 2,000 meters in average above sea level. The highest mountain is Mount Taibai. A: (78) _______________________? B: It’s more than 3,700 meters high. A: I guess there must be many animals in the Qinling Mountains. Are there any valuable animals? B: (79) _______________________ Many valuable animals live there, such as pandas, golden monkeys and so on. They are home to wildlife. A: I see. (80) _______________________. B: I quite agree with you. That’s why many people say the Qinling Mountains are the lungs (肺) of Shaanxi Province. So we have worked a lot to protect the green mountains.
补全第 76 空。

sections.prompt: 以 Sports 为主题，不少于70词，任选其一：1. 谁在体育活动中对你帮助最大、如何帮助、你取得什么进步；2. 你遇到什么困难、如何克服、有什么改变或感受。不得出现真实个人信息，如用人名请选择 Mr. Liu / Ms. Wang / Ma Li / Wang Gang。开头：These days, we have more time to do sports. We experienced more and surely made progress. As for me, ...
points: 说明帮助者或遇到的困难
sections.sample: We experienced more and surely made progress. As for me, I can’t forget my friend Wang Gang. Wang Gang is good at playing basketball, but I wasn’t. Wang Gang saw this and came to help me. He showed me how to move the ball and trained me how to pass or catch the ball. After that, he encouraged me to play it with others. He had a great influence on me. I started to play better and better. The more I played it, the more I liked it. Now we’re both in the class team. I will never forget his help and I will help others like him!
sections.exp: 两种任务只选一种，按人物或问题、过程、结果展开，讲经历以过去时为主。
